observations.title: Failure to test identity of each component and verify supplier data
observations.summary: The firm did not conduct any test to verify the identity of each component of a drug product and did not validate or periodically verify the reliability of supplier test analyses.

observations.title: Failure to test finished product for identity, strength, and microbiology before release
observations.summary: The firm failed to perform appropriate laboratory testing for each batch to confirm identity, strength, and absence of objectionable microorganisms prior to product release.

observations.title: Quality control unit did not exercise required authority and responsibilities
observations.summary: The quality control unit failed to ensure compliance with CGMP, including lacking written procedures, complete batch records, stability data, and adequate authority.
